intro_section.title: Explore Beyond Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica
paragraphs: Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique is a luxury resort on the Gulf of Papagayo, approximately 32 to 40 minutes from Liberia airport (LIR). When you are ready to step outside the resort for the day, Wild Papagayo organizes private tours with direct pickup from the hotel.

Every experience in this guide departs from and returns to Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica. Day trips range from a shorter outing of about six hours to full days of eight or nine hours in Costa Rica's national parks, volcanic landscapes and wildlife reserves. Exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your selected experience and travel date.
One group. One vehicle. One guide. No shared buses. No other travelers on your schedule.

featured_tours.title: Six Private Tours from Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica

tours.note: Swim at Llanos del Cortes waterfall, then visit Las Pumas Wildlife Rescue Center — pumas, jaguars, ocelots and monkeys. Lunch included. About 6 hours.
Hidden waterfalls and tropical forest, reserved exclusively for your group. Certified bilingual guide. About 8 hours. Minimum age 4.
Las Pailas Trail through fumaroles and mud pots at Rincón de la Vieja. Classic (waterfall) or Plus (hot springs) options. About 8 hours. Runs Tuesday through Sunday — park closed Mondays.
Three suspension bridges, Llanos de Cortez waterfall and a sloth encounter. Lunch included. Sightings are frequent but not guaranteed. About 9 hours.
Full-day hike to Río Celeste at Tenorio Volcano National Park. Swimming is not permitted in the river. Park entrance fee included. About 9 hours. Minimum age 8.
Covered boat through Palo Verde National Park. Crocodiles, howler monkeys and tropical birds along the Tempisque River. Half day. Ages 2+.

faq.q: Can Wild Papagayo arrange pickup directly from Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica?
faq.a: Yes. Wild Papagayo coordinates direct resort pickup from Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique. Exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your selected tour and travel date.

faq.q: What private tours are available from Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica?
faq.a: Six tours are listed in this guide, ranging from about 6 to about 9 hours: Waterfall & Las Pumas, Waterfall Lovers, Rincón de la Vieja Hiking, Hanging Bridges & Sloths, Celeste River Hike and Palo Verde River Boat. All include direct resort pickup.

faq.q: How long is the drive from Waldorf Astoria to Rincón de la Vieja?
faq.a: As general Papagayo-area planning context, the drive is approximately 102 to 130 minutes each way. Actual travel time depends on the hotel pickup location, route, and road conditions. The hiking tour takes about 8 hours and runs Tuesday through Sunday, as the national park is closed on Mondays.

faq.q: Is the Celeste River Hike worth the drive from Waldorf Astoria?
faq.a: Yes, for travelers who want a full nature day and are comfortable with a longer drive. Approximately 2 to 2.5 hours each way, depending on the pickup location and road conditions. The hike itself takes about 9 hours and is rated Moderate. Swimming is not permitted in Río Celeste. Park registration requires visitor identification details.

faq.q: Are tours at Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica private?
faq.a: Yes. Every Wild Papagayo experience is reserved exclusively for your group. No shared buses, no other travelers added to your group.

faq.q: What is the shortest day trip from Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica?
faq.a: Waterfall & Las Pumas is the shortest at about 6 hours, rated Easy and suitable for all ages. It combines a waterfall swim with a guided visit to Las Pumas Wildlife Rescue Center, where the animals are rescued rather than wild.

faq.q: Can children join tours from Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica?
faq.a: Most tours in this guide are suitable for children. The Celeste River Hike has a minimum age of 8, and Waterfall Lovers has a minimum age of 4. Let us know the ages of your group when planning, and we'll confirm what works for your family.
